records.text: It was a direct shot to Charlie Kirk's heart, where the area started going red.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep VMNWMXX1vO8)

appearances.snippet: It was a direct shot to the heart. It looked like right where his heart is, it started going red.

verification.notes: Verification is limited to conveyance: the available interview footage records this eyewitness describing a direct shot to the heart and reddening in that area. Later official reporting places the wound in the neck, so this result does not endorse the witness interpretation.

sources.title: Witness lineup interview clip and transcript
sources.relevance: Preserves the eyewitness wording describing a direct shot to the heart and reddening.

records.text: The three NBC News eyewitnesses intentionally provided false accounts that Charlie Kirk was hit in the chest or heart.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Ladies and gentlemen, they are not guessing. They are providing a description that never happened. It never happened. ... And yet they described that as if it was pre-planned for them to go out there. I'm going to investigate these people who came out here and said this right near his heart. ... Because that is way too specific. They are providing false witness intentionally.

verification.notes: The eyewitness clips confirm that several people initially described a chest or heart impact, while other witnesses and later official reporting described a neck wound. No source establishes that the three witnesses coordinated or intentionally lied; stress, vantage point, and ordinary eyewitness error remain plausible.
